description: One League of Legends account by Riot ID: identity (Riot ID, level, primary role, linked public persona), current ranked solo/duo standing with wins/losses, this split's peak, apex ladder rank (null below Master), the most-played champions with win rate/KDA/CS per minute, and recent form summarised from the last 20 solo games (wins, losses, win rate, average K/D/A). `indexed: false` means TrackDIFF has not seen this account; no data is fetched on demand. Win rates are 0–1 fractions; timestamps are Unix ms. For the game they are in right now use `get_player_live_game`.
name: get_player_profile
title: Player profile
